title: IRIS KGeoJSON track message
description: Transcribed from the IRIS KGeoJSON Service ICD. Same message on MQTT (primary) and UDP (optional). Units per ICD: altitude feet MSL, speed knots, angles degrees, timestamp epoch ms.

source.description: Unique name of the data provider/sensor; displayed to the user

displayName.description: Name displayed in the track's data-block

altitude.description: Altitude MSL in feet (ICD usage: TBD)

status.description: If omitted, the service uses its configured expiry

course.description: Course over ground, degrees. Omit for no velocity vector

speed.description: Speed in knots. Omit for no velocity vector

properties.description: Key-value pairs shown as-is in the metadata panel
